# 1. Load Libraries and Source Functions

```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcompView)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

source("analysis/scripts/appressorium_assay.R")
```

# 2. Data Loading and Plotting
```{r}
raw_dir <- here("raw")
raw_file <- "appressoria_phenotype.csv"

# Define strain order (reversed for horizontal plot)
my_strain_order <- rev(c("Guy11", "mst7", "WT_9.2", "WT_12.2",
                         "PM_1.1", "PM_3.1", "PD_1.3", "PD_3.5"))

# Create clean and annotated boxplots
boxplot_clean <- plot_appressoria_boxplot_no_signif(
  file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
  strain_order = my_strain_order)

boxplot_plt <- plot_appressoria_boxplot(
  file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
  strain_order = my_strain_order,
  annotate_significance = TRUE)

print(boxplot_plt)
```

## Chi-square tests of count data

```{r}
chi_square_results <- chi_square_appressoria(file.path(raw_dir, raw_file))
print(chi_square_results)
```

## One-way ANOVA

```{r}
# Perform one-way ANOVA
anova_result <- perform_appressoria_anova(file.path(raw_dir, raw_file))
anova_summary <- summary(anova_result)
print(anova_summary)

# Extract p-value and F-statistic from ANOVA
anova_pvalue <- anova_summary[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]
anova_fstat <- anova_summary[[1]]$`F value`[1]
```

## Tukey Post-hoc Test

```{r}
# Perform Tukey HSD test
tukey_result <- perform_appressoria_tukey(file.path(raw_dir, raw_file))
print(tukey_result)
```

## Save Figure

```{r}
# Save the clean boxplot
ggsave(
  filename = here("figures/Horizontal_Boxplot_appressoria.svg"),
  plot = boxplot_clean,
  width = 6,
  height = 8
)
```

## Save Figure with Statistics

```{r}
# Save the boxplot with significance annotations
ggsave(
  filename = here("figures/Horizontal_Boxplot_appressoria_with_stats.svg"),
  plot = boxplot_plt,
  width = 6,
  height = 8
)

write.csv(
  chi_square_results,
  here("figures/appressoria_chi_square_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
